system.description:
Favoured weapon: Sword, Short

Granted power: Advantage on Stealth and sleight of hand. Once/day, while in shadow: you are Invisible until the end of your next turn. A Smite you make while Hidden doesn't reveal you.

Allegiance: Chaotic Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Mask in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: steal one thing thought impossible to take (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
